stages.purpose: plan the question into facets, select healthy search providers, and collect first-party, code, and social evidence
read text and media; use platform skills to acquire media, then captions/ASR, bounded visual inspection, and comments
deduplicate, score relevance/directness/authority/recency/independence, detect contradictions, discard weak evidence, and replan gaps
render a table with conclusion, confidence, evidence, source access, and limitations

videoPolicy.globalPass: Use transcript anchors, scene boundaries, low-rate frames, and semantic retrieval to locate candidate intervals.
videoPolicy.localPass: Ask the VLM for dense frames only inside candidate intervals; return visual segments with absolute timestamps.
videoPolicy.contextPolicy: Pass compact timestamped observations and citations to the reasoning model; never pass the full media blob by default.
videoPolicy.timestampMapping: Preserve absolute source milliseconds when clips are cropped; include clipStartMs and padding in adapter metadata.
replanWhen: candidate interval has no supporting visual evidence
coverage remains below the claim requirement
